commits.message:
[compiler](feat) support multibuffer_mode option (#2439)

Accept multibuffer_mode dictionaries and forward them to NPU IR on the A2/A3 and 950 compilation paths. Reject simultaneous num_stages values while preserving existing legacy option behavior.

Keep Config, autotune and JSON caches compatible with the new option using stable immutable pairs, and add regression coverage for forwarding, conflicts and cache restoration.

Validation: Python AST parsing for all 7 changed files and git diff --check passed. Pytest and real NPU IR/device validation have not been run.

Signed-off-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>
Co-authored-by: KanuaK <yihan_z@qq.com>

commits.message:
[DiscreteMask](fix) run atomic_rmw with cont-ptr and disc-mask in SIMD mode (#2418)

Keep the mixCompileDiscreteMask bail-out in DiscreteMaskAtomicConversion
only for unstructured pointers: they need the SIMT indirect atomic ABI,
which consumes the original lane mask. Structured pointers do not need
the indirect ABI and take the plain SIMD select+atomic rewrite instead.

Pointer structure is decided with OffsetAnalysis (triton::parse), the
same analysis TritonToUnstructure relies on, so both passes agree on
the verdict and structured accesses still reach the structured lowering.
The verdict is memoized on the op itself as an ExplictRouteToSIMD bool
attribute: the greedy driver re-matches ops many times, and an
attribute cannot dangle the way a cached Value would when the driver
erases the ops behind it.
